aum.raw: managing assets from ~KRW 1.5 trillion C&M sale

strategy.thesis: Family office of Lee Min-joo, who sold cable operator C&M in 2008 for ~KRW 1.5 trillion; controls listed VC Atinum Investment, which runs large 'one fund' growth-stage vehicles backing Korean tech leaders.

application.how_to_apply: Investment via Atinum Investment (listed VC subsidiary)

summary.en: Atinum Partners is widely cited as the pioneer of the Korean family-office model. Founded by Lee Min-joo to manage the ~KRW 1.5 trillion proceeds from selling cable operator C&M in 2008, it controls the listed venture firm Atinum Investment, which deploys large growth-stage 'one fund' vehicles into Korean tech companies such as Dunamu, Kakao Games and Pearl Abyss.
summary.local: 이민주 회장이 2008년 C&M 매각 대금 약 1조5000억원을 운용하기 위해 설립한 한국 패밀리오피스의 시초로 꼽힌다. 상장 VC인 에이티넘인베스트먼트를 지배하며 두나무·카카오게임즈·펄어비스 등에 투자했다.

sources.title: 에이티넘파트너스(사모투자조합) - 기업정보
sources.supports: Family office origin, Seoul HQ, team size, link to Atinum Investment
sources.quote: Atinum Partners is recognized as Korea's pioneering family office, established by Chairman Lee Min-joo following his 2008 sale of C&M (cable broadcaster) for approximately 1.5 trillion won to professionally manage resulting assets.

sources.title: 두나무로 대박 난 에이티넘, 역대 최대 '8000억' 블라인드 펀드 조성한다
sources.quote: In 2022, Atinum Investment established the 'Atinum Growth Fund 2022' with 800 billion won in assets, with the National Pension Service as the anchor limited partner.

sources.title: 에이티넘인베스트먼트 - 위키백과
sources.supports: Atinum Partners is major shareholder (~33.46%) of listed Atinum Investment; portfolio 100+
sources.quote: Atinum Partners and one other shareholder hold approximately 33.46% of the company

sources.title: 에이티넘인베스트먼트 - 투자 포트폴리오 기업 131개사
sources.supports: Portfolio count of 131 companies via Atinum Investment

verification_notes: Atinum Partners (the family-office holding/PEF) controls the publicly listed VC Atinum Investment (KRX: 021080); venture activity is executed through the subsidiary. THE VC lists a 1988 registration date for the corporate shell, but news sources consistently date the family-office function to the 2008–2009 C&M sale. Fund figures relate to Atinum Investment.

strategy.thesis: Family office of Won Jae-yeon, who sold cable TV operator Quirix to t-broad for ~KRW 350 billion; operates a licensed new-technology finance company (신기사) and co-manages PEF/venture funds alongside emerging managers.

summary.en: Genitas is the family-office vehicle of Won Jae-yeon, chairman of Gaiser Partners, who sold cable operator Quirix to t-broad for ~KRW 350 billion. Established in 2013 as a licensed new-technology business finance company (신기사), it manages roughly KRW 300 billion and acts as co-GP on private equity and venture funds with newer managers.
summary.local: 큐릭스를 티브로드에 약 3500억원에 매각한 원재연 회장(가이저파트너스)이 2013년 세운 패밀리오피스로, 신기술사업금융사를 설립해 3000억원대 자금을 운용하며 신생 PEF와 공동운용사를 맡는다.

sources.title: 염전 부자에서 한샘 창업자까지…패밀리오피스에 글로벌PE까지 줄서는 이유
sources.supports: Founder, Quirix sale price, founding year, ~KRW 300bn under management, 신기사 co-GP role
sources.quote: 원재연 가이저파트너스 회장은 2009년 유선방송 큐릭스를 티브로드에 3500억원에 매각한 후, 2013년 신기술사업금융사(신기사)인 제니타스를 세워 3000억원대 자금을 운용하고 있습니다. ... 제니타스는 신기사를 설립해 신생PEF와 공동운용사를 맡아 수익을 나누는 역할을 합니다.

verification_notes: Sale price of Quirix cited as ~KRW 3,500억 (350 billion) and reported sale year varies (2009 in one source, ~2013 founding of Genitas). Romanization of 원재연 also appears as Won Jae-yeon/Won Jae-yun. No public website or THE VC portfolio page located; confidence capped at medium pending primary documentation.

strategy.thesis: Company-builder family office of the Korean founder of Hong Kong/China-based Cowell Group; combines internal business ideas, talent and 'perpetual capital' to build new startups and makes direct equity (VC/PE/M&A) investments in early-stage companies.

summary.en: Cowell Partners is a company-builder-style startup holding company and family office founded by the Korean entrepreneur behind Hong Kong/China-based Cowell Group (camera-module maker Cowell e Holdings). It combines internally conceived business ideas, talent and permanent capital to create new startups, and makes direct equity investments via VC/PE/M&A in early-stage companies.
summary.local: 홍콩·중국 기반 코웰그룹(코웰이홀딩스)을 창업한 한국인 창업주가 세운 컴퍼니빌더형 스타트업 지주회사이자 패밀리오피스로, 사업 아이디어·인재·만기 없는 자본을 결합해 직접 스타트업을 만들고 초기 기업에 자기자본을 투자한다.

sources.title: 코웰파트너스 기업, 채용, 투자, 뉴스
sources.supports: Company-builder family office, direct equity (VC/PE/M&A), Seoul HQ, team size 4, representative Lee Young-min
sources.quote: 코웰파트너스는 홍콩/중국 기반 코웰그룹의 한국인 창업주가 직접 한국에 설립한 컴퍼니빌더형 스타트업 지주회사이자 패밀리 오피스입니다. ... 스타트업 형태로 회사를 직접 새롭게 만드는 컴퍼니빌딩과 초기 스타트업에 대한 자기자본 투자를 진행하고 있습니다.

verification_notes: Self-describes as a family office + company builder doing direct equity in early startups (RocketPunch). Specific portfolio companies, founding year as the family office, and capital figures not disclosed publicly. RocketPunch lists a 1998 corporate registration date that likely predates the family-office function; left founded_year null.

strategy.thesis: Family office of Ko Sa-mu-yeol, who founded and sold CDN company CDNetworks in 2014; invests proceeds into venture/startup deals and operating businesses (including an education acquisition).

summary.en: KO Investment is the family office of Ko Sa-mu-yeol, founder of CDN provider CDNetworks, who sold the company in 2014 and set up the firm the same year to invest in venture and startup deals (it also acquired the education brand Gaenyeomwonri/개념원리).
summary.local: 씨디네트웍스를 창업해 2014년 매각한 고사무열 대표가 같은 해 세운 패밀리오피스로, 매각 수익을 기반으로 벤처·스타트업 투자 사업을 영위한다(교육기업 개념원리 인수 등).

sources.title: 염전 부자에서 한샘 창업자까지…패밀리오피스에 글로벌PE까지 줄서는 이유
sources.supports: Founder Ko Sa-mu-yeol, CDNetworks sale in 2014, family office founded same year
sources.quote: 씨디네트웍스를 창업해 2014년 매각한 고사무열 씨도 같은 해 패밀리오피스인 케이오인베스트먼트를 세웠습니다.

sources.title: (주)케이오인베스트먼트 기업정보
sources.quote: 케이오인베스트먼트는 2000년부터 벤처 기업을 설립하여 성공적으로 이끈 경영 능력을 기반으로 신설된 투자 전문 회사입니다.

verification_notes: Confirmed as an exit-founder family office investing in venture/startup deals; one source notes a KRW 45 billion education-company acquisition, so it is not a pure venture investor. No public website or portfolio list located; fund/check sizes undisclosed.

strategy.thesis: Investment arm of the family behind luxury-handbag ODM giant Simone; runs private-equity/M&A and asset-management vehicles and incubates emerging fashion designers/brands by providing manufacturing support in exchange for equity.

summary.en: Simone Investment is the investment vehicle of Chairman Park Eun-kwan's family, owners of luxury-handbag ODM leader Simone. Established in 2010, it runs private-equity/M&A funds and asset-management entities, and incubates emerging fashion designers and brands by providing manufacturing and QC support in exchange for an equity stake.
summary.local: 명품 핸드백 ODM 기업 시몬느 박은관 회장 일가의 투자 회사로 2010년 설립됐다. PEF·M&A 펀드와 자산운용 계열을 운영하며, 생산·품질관리를 지원하는 대가로 지분을 받는 방식으로 신진 디자이너·브랜드를 인큐베이팅한다.

sources.title: 시몬느인베스트먼트(사모투자조합) - 기업정보
sources.supports: Founding 2010, Seoul HQ, parent company Simone, PE/M&A funds
sources.quote: Established in April 2010, Simone Investment is a Korean private equity firm ... The company maintains parent company status under Simone (시몬느), a handbag manufacturer and accessory conglomerate.

sources.title: [CEO&Story] 박은관 시몬느 회장
sources.supports: Planned KRW 300–600bn fund, brand-incubation model in exchange for equity
sources.quote: 박 회장은 "자회사 시몬느인베스트먼트를 통해 3,000억~6,000억원 규모의 펀드를 결성하고 기관 투자도 받을 예정"이라고 말했습니다. ... 일부 지분을 받는 형식으로 브랜드 인큐베이팅에도 나서고 있으며, 현재는 해외 신진 디자이너 2명을 지원하고 있고 점차 확대할 계획입니다.

verification_notes: Founder-wealth family-office vehicle leaning toward PE/M&A and consumer/fashion brand incubation rather than classic early-stage VC; THE VC shows only 4 disclosed investments and the entity reports zero employees on the PEF shell. The KRW 300–600bn fund was a stated plan, not a confirmed close.

strategy.thesis: Family office of the family behind salt-farm/real-estate group Sungdam; a prominent Korean LP that commits primarily to private-equity funds (e.g., Blackstone, KKR) and real assets rather than direct startup investing.

summary.en: Sungdam is one of Korea's best-known family offices, built on salt-farm and real-estate wealth (its forerunner Hwaseongsa was the country's largest sea-salt producer). It manages roughly KRW 300 billion and is mainly active as a limited partner in private-equity funds (Blackstone, KKR and others) and real assets rather than as a direct venture investor.
summary.local: 국내 최대 천일염 생산 염전 법인 화성사를 모태로 한 부동산·금융 가문의 패밀리오피스로, 약 3000억원을 운용한다. 직접 벤처 투자보다는 블랙스톤·KKR 등 사모펀드의 LP로 주로 활동한다.

sources.title: '염전부자' 성담, 대체투자업계 숨은 LP로 주목
sources.supports: Salt-farm origin, ~KRW 300bn, PEF LP since 2011 (KRW 10bn → 40bn by 2021), Blackstone/KKR
sources.quote: 성담은 ... 금융 투자 규모는 3000억원에 달하며 ... 2011년부터 PEF에만 100억원을 투자하기 시작했으며, 매년 100억원 남짓이던 PEF 출자액은 2021년 400억까지 늘었습니다. ... 2015년에 블랙스톤이 운영하는 부동산 블라인드 펀드에 출자했습니다. ... 최근 KKR 등 글로벌 운용사들도 펀딩을 위해 성담을 찾는다.

verification_notes: Included because it is one of Korea's most-cited family offices, but it is primarily a fund LP and real-asset investor, not a direct startup/venture investor. Its venture exposure is indirect (via PEF/VC fund commitments). Romanization of family names approximate. Confidence low for the 'venture-active' classification.
